paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the generation length comparison between Vanilla CoT and TLDR (Ours) across four benchmark datasets, namely GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B model. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled with the dataset names in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis is labeled "Generation Length (words)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8000, marked at intervals of 1000. For each dataset, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a light red bar representing Vanilla CoT and a dark red bar representing TLDR (Ours). The generation lengths for Vanilla CoT are approximately 679, 2951, 6701, and 4584 words for GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, respectively. The corresponding generation lengths for TLDR (Ours) are approximately 237, 2038, 6436, and 3850 words, with percentage changes of -65%, -31%, -4%, and -16% relative to Vanilla CoT. The bars are grouped by dataset, with no specific sorting order beyond the fixed category order on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color distinction between Vanilla CoT and TLDR (Ours).
